title: India's electronics exports jumped 57% in a single month.
sources: Forbes India - India's July export growth hits four-year high of 19.6%
DD News - India's total exports rise 13.31% to USD 80.14 bn in July 2026 (Ministry of Commerce data)
caption:
India's electronics exports jumped 57% in a single month.

Up from $3.76 billion in July 2025 - a 57.4% year-on-year jump, the third-fastest-growing export category that month, per Commerce Ministry data.

Total merchandise exports rose 19.63% to $44.24 billion that month. Combined goods and services exports climbed 13.31% to $80.14 billion - the strongest July on record in four years.

A category that once ran as a trade deficit is now one of the fastest-growing export lines in the country's economy. That shift doesn't happen in one month - it happens because factory capacity was already there when demand arrived.
